items.title: United States
kv: GENIUS payment stablecoins are private issuer liabilities backed by eligible reserve assets and a statutory redemption framework; the Act does not make them federally insured or government-guaranteed dollars. The Federal Reserve's proposed prudential rule would require covered issuers to maintain fair-value reserves at least equal to outstanding issuance at all times, calculate the position daily as of 5 p.m., remediate deficiencies within 24 hours, and meet a proposed two-business-day redemption standard. A tokenized bank deposit remains a bank-deposit claim. A DTC token is a controlled representation inside DTC's entitlement architecture rather than native bearer title to the underlying security. OUSD is a Bridge-issued stablecoin whose launch page names BlackRock, Lead Bank and BNY reserve roles; the first promised monthly attestation had not yet been published.
Reserve assets, issuer liability, holder priority, deposit insurance, custody and central-bank money are different property and protection layers.

items.title: Japan
kv: JPYSC is a specified-trust beneficiary claim backed by trust assets and is neither legal tender, a bank deposit nor deposit-insured. The 30 June snapshot disclosed ¥10,008,294,794 issued and ¥10,008,304,794 in the trust's deposit account. When a customer lends JPYSC to SBI VC Trade, that customer instead holds an unsecured consumption-loan repayment claim outside customer-asset segregation. DCJPY is an issuing-bank deposit backed by the bank's balance sheet. A future retail CBDC or tokenized BOJ current-account balance would be a BOJ claim only if legally and operationally issued.
Trust segregation, an intermediary loan claim, commercial-bank deposit insurance and a direct central-bank liability are different protections and failure paths.

items.title: Singapore
kv: Licensed DPT providers must apply trust, safeguarding and recordkeeping rules to customer assets. The future MAS-SCS model would add one-for-one reserves, capital, par redemption, disclosure, stress testing and wind-down requirements, but is not yet an operating issuer regime. The Swift-ledger transactions recorded separate DBS, OCBC and UOB tokenized-deposit obligations on each bank's infrastructure. Crypto in DBS custody, DBS structured notes, OCBC commercial paper and GOLDX fund tokens are different customer assets or securities; wholesale CBDC and MEPS+ balances are MAS liabilities for bounded eligible participants.
Safeguarding, reserve coverage, redemption, bank liability, central-bank money and deposit protection are separate claims; none guarantees market value or instant failure recovery.

items.title: New Zealand
kv: The NZDD designation requires ECDD to hold NZD at least equal to the underlying currency amount of NZDD in circulation, as trustee on bare trust for holders, in a trust account whose assets are call debt securities issued by registered banks. Eligible account holders may return tokens and require NZD delivery, subject to commercially reasonable restrictions. The designation does not state that the token holder is the registered bank's depositor or that NZDD is DCS protected; only eligible covered deposits receive DCS compensation. Digital Cash would be an RBNZ-issued government-backed NZD liability if approved, while ESAS balances already are central-bank money for approved participants.

One-to-one reserve quantity, bare-trust property rights, an issuer-mediated redemption right, the bank's deposit debt, DCS eligibility, central-bank money and market-price stability are separate claims.

items.title: Brazil
kv: For fiat-referenced virtual assets offered by in-country providers, Resolution 520 requires review and disclosure of issuer, fiat or same-sovereign public-debt reserves, custody, audited material and available redemption or reserve-claim mechanisms, and bars algorithmically controlled reserves. Disclosure and reserve eligibility do not prove one-to-one reserves, direct customer title, stress redemption, deposit insurance, legal tender or a sovereign guarantee; an MPT mirror does not displace the named official CSD record.

items.title: South Africa
kv: Crypto is not SARB-issued, backed or guaranteed, and no dedicated prudential stablecoin-issuer licence was located. ZARU is a current private issuer structure: Loop South Africa, trading as BlockTower, is the issuer and FSP; Standard Bank holds cash and deposit reserves and provides securities custody; Sanlam Investment Management holds or manages the money-market portion; and Moore performs monthly agreed-upon procedures. The 31 July snapshot reported R23.314 million of cash and bank deposits plus R30.403 million of money-market funds against 52.946 million ZARU. Direct mint and redemption are limited by the whitepaper to verified institutional clients; retail or other holders use authorized partners. The report says Loop is the bank account holder and fund investor, so a token holder has an issuer redemption claim rather than a bank deposit in their own name. Khokha 2 wCBDC and bank tokens were experimental liabilities inside a proof of concept.

FSP authorization, asset custody, issuer debt, reserve account title, reserve-asset custody, direct redemption, agreed-upon procedures, deposit insurance and sovereign guarantee are distinct claims; the AUP report is not an audit or assurance opinion.

items.title: Hong Kong
kv: A specified-stablecoin holder has a par-redemption right, ordinarily within one business day after a valid request. Reserve assets must support outstanding obligations, be segregated and protected through effective trust arrangements; insolvency rights include pro-rata reserve-pool disposal and a shortfall claim against the issuer. HKDAP's whitepaper identifies Anchorpoint as debtor, Ethereum as its initial chain, Standard Chartered Hong Kong as reserve manager and intended custodian, Standard Chartered Trustee as trustee for non-digital reserve assets, and a wholesale authorised-distributor model. At 23 September Anchorpoint's weekly unaudited statement reported HK$1,006,890 in circulation and HK$2,110,045 of reserves, of which HK$1.1 million was issuer-funded overcollateralisation. Independent attestations had not begun. HSBC says RedCoin will be fully backed by segregated liquid assets and redeemable one-for-one, but the product remained future-tense.

A statutory claim, whitepaper, unaudited issuer statement and supervisory rule do not prove continuous reserve sufficiency, an independent attestation, liquidity under stress or a completed redemption; issuer equity-funded overcollateralisation is not additional circulating customer money.

items.title: China
kv: A commercial-bank e-CNY wallet is an account-based liability of that bank, may earn interest, enters its reserve base and receives deposit-equivalent insurance treatment. A nonbank wallet is the provider's liability backed by 100% e-CNY guarantee funds. Deposit insurance currently pays covered principal and interest up to CNY 500,000 per depositor aggregated at one insured institution, with excess claims in liquidation. Private virtual-currency losses may be self-borne when the civil act violates public order, while criminal tracing and restitution remain separate.
PBOC governance, bank liability, provider liability, required guarantee funds, deposit insurance, liquidation claim, criminal seizure and actual victim recovery are not interchangeable protections.

cells.text: GENIUS payment stablecoins are private issuer liabilities backed by eligible reserve assets and a statutory redemption framework; the Act does not make them federally insured or government-guaranteed dollars. The Federal Reserve's proposed prudential rule would require covered issuers to maintain fair-value reserves at least equal to outstanding issuance at all times, calculate the position daily as of 5 p.m., remediate deficiencies within 24 hours, and meet a proposed two-business-day redemption standard. A tokenized bank deposit remains a bank-deposit claim. A DTC token is a controlled representation inside DTC's entitlement architecture rather than native bearer title to the underlying security. OUSD is a Bridge-issued stablecoin whose launch page names BlackRock, Lead Bank and BNY reserve roles; the first promised monthly attestation had not yet been published.

cells.text: JPYSC is a specified-trust beneficiary claim backed by trust assets and is neither legal tender, a bank deposit nor deposit-insured. cells.text: The NZDD designation requires ECDD to hold NZD at least equal to the underlying currency amount of NZDD in circulation, as trustee on bare trust for holders, in a trust account whose assets are call debt securities issued by registered banks. Eligible account holders may return tokens and require NZD delivery, subject to commercially reasonable restrictions. The designation does not state that the token holder is the registered bank's depositor or that NZDD is DCS protected; only eligible covered deposits receive DCS compensation. Digital Cash would be an RBNZ-issued government-backed NZD liability if approved, while ESAS balances already are central-bank money for approved participants.

cells.text: Crypto is not SARB-issued, backed or guaranteed, and no dedicated prudential stablecoin-issuer licence was located. The 31 July snapshot reported R23.314 million of cash and bank deposits plus R30.403 million of money-market funds against 52.946 million ZARU. Direct mint and redemption are limited by the whitepaper to verified institutional clients; retail or other holders use authorized partners. The report says Loop is the bank account holder and fund investor, so a token holder has an issuer redemption claim rather than a bank deposit in their own name. Khokha 2 wCBDC and bank tokens were experimental liabilities inside a proof of concept.

cells.text: A specified-stablecoin holder has a par-redemption right, ordinarily within one business day after a valid request. Reserve assets must support outstanding obligations, be segregated and protected through effective trust arrangements; insolvency rights include pro-rata reserve-pool disposal and a shortfall claim against the issuer. HKDAP's whitepaper identifies Anchorpoint as debtor, Ethereum as its initial chain, Standard Chartered Hong Kong as reserve manager and intended custodian, Standard Chartered Trustee as trustee for non-digital reserve assets, and a wholesale authorised-distributor model. At 23 September Anchorpoint's weekly unaudited statement reported HK$1,006,890 in circulation and HK$2,110,045 of reserves, of which HK$1.1 million was issuer-funded overcollateralisation. Independent attestations had not begun. HSBC says RedCoin will be fully backed by segregated liquid assets and redeemable one-for-one, but the product remained future-tense.

Private virtual-currency losses may be self-borne when the civil act violates public order, while criminal tracing and restitution remain separate.
